retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast sepia urban portrait featuring extreme low-angle perspective and hand-drawn graffiti-style typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central vertical frame containing a sepia-toned, low-angle photograph of two figures against a brutalist building, surrounded by a dark, textured border with vibrant red hand-drawn lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme low-angle perspective creating a sense of dominance and scale
High-contrast sepia palette against a dark, textured outer frame
Vibrant red gestural typography cutting across the monochromatic image
Rough, distressed borders suggesting physical film or print artifacts
coreInvariants: Hand-drawn, horizontal-stretch typography in a single accent color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the central frame, scaled large due to the close-up low-angle lens.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharp, triangular peak of the brutalist building in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-right text, follows the building's edge down to the figures, and rests on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The bright sky area around the building peak provides breathing room within the tight frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and sepia tones for the photographic subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/cream for the highlights and sky area.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant, saturated red for the graphic typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast; the red text provides the only high-chroma element.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended, gestural script with horizontal emphasis.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'E' and 'L' are flattened into long horizontal bars
Ascenders and descenders are minimized to maintain a linear band
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style gestural lettering used for both artist and title to maintain a raw, unified aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, urban energy of the original lettering.
If a font must be used, an extended sans with a 'rough' filter could approximate the width.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned, high-contrast, low-angle photograph of two men in urban attire standing in front of a sharp-angled brutalist building. Surround the image with a thick, dark, distressed border that looks like old film stock.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn, scratchy red lettering in an ultra-extended horizontal style. Place one line in the top right and one line in the bottom left, ensuring the strokes are thin and aggressive.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly sepia and red?
Is the text horizontally stretched and scratchy?
Does the border look distressed and dark?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text is vibrant against the sepia.
Ensure the low-angle perspective makes the building look imposing.
Verify the border has a 'found' or 'damaged' quality.
Confirm the typography is ultra-wide and scratchy.
recipe.reuseFormula: Sepia Urban Portrait + Low Angle + Distressed Border + Red Scratchy Script
